$comment: Per-module data shared by the harness (registry.tsx), the recorder (record-tape.mjs) and the shooter. `record` is the /bridge-exec step list that brings the RUNNING app to the page while the tape rolls; `boot` lists commands the page needs from app boot (store preloads) that the recorder invokes itself so they land on the tape; `fill` answers commands a recording session does not reach on its own (they are appended as wildcards only when absent, and named in the tape's note).
